data.notes: September 2026 is already anchored by major arena concerts, Concertgebouw special programs, and a packed 12 September festival weekend spanning Amsterdam urban culture and Ibiza-bred house/techno.

events.title: Stars in Concert: Nikola Meeuwsen, Emma Kok, Nicola Benedetti, Caro Emerald & Sonya Yoncheva
events.summary: A European Culture Prize concert bringing together Nikola Meeuwsen, Emma Kok, Nicola Benedetti, the Caro Emerald project, Sonya Yoncheva and the National Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands.

events.title: Kumar Sanu & Anuradha Paudwal Live in Concert
events.summary: Bollywood playback icons Kumar Sanu and Anuradha Paudwal perform a nostalgia-focused concert at AFAS Live, presented by Raga Events.

events.title: Ronnie Wood and his band
events.summary: Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood plays Paradiso with his band, marking a notable return 31 years after The Rolling Stones’ 1995 Paradiso appearances.

events.title: Melanie Martinez: HADES: THE SACRIFICE
events.summary: Melanie Martinez brings the HADES: THE SACRIFICE arena tour to Ziggo Dome, presenting her cinematic alt-pop universe in Amsterdam.

events.title: The Waterboys: The Fisherman’s Blues Revue featuring Steve Earle
events.summary: The Waterboys perform a special Fisherman’s Blues Revue at AFAS Live with Steve Earle and returning fiddler Steve Wickham.

events.title: Hiromi & Metropole Orkest
events.summary: Pianist Hiromi joins the Metropole Orkest, conducted by Miho Hazama, for a jazz-fusion and orchestral program in the Concertgebouw Main Hall.

events.title: Parels van de Stad 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam’s urban culture festival returns to Riekerhaven for two days with 150+ artists across nine stages, including Yade Lauren, Lil Kleine, Jonna Fraser, Broederliefde, Monica Geuze and Idaly.

events.title: Circoloco Amsterdam
events.summary: Circoloco brings its Ibiza underground house and techno brand back to NDSM-werf for a daytime electronic dance festival.

events.title: Fairuz Our Muse, featuring Amsterdam Sinfonietta, Nai Barghouti & Wasim Arslan
events.summary: Amsterdam Sinfonietta, Nai Barghouti and Wasim Arslan perform a Concertgebouw tribute to Fairuz, curated as a cross-cultural homage to her repertoire.

events.title: Curated by Break
events.summary: Drum & bass selector Break headlines Melkweg’s Curated by night, joined by Breakage, Kira, Nymfo, VOXI & Leks and Innate MC.

events.title: Blockhead, ProleteR, Arms and Sleepers
events.summary: Blockhead, ProleteR and Arms and Sleepers bring their autumn 2026 European tour to Bitterzoet for a night of instrumental hip-hop, downtempo and electronic grooves.

events.title: Anastacia: #NTK Tour
events.summary: Anastacia performs at AFAS Live on the #NTK Tour, celebrating the 25th anniversary of her debut album Not That Kind and her greatest hits.
